primary_evaluation: Deployed output: an abstained answer receives score 0; a released answer is scored against the BioASQ gold answer.
secondary_evaluation: Raw generated-answer score before verifier abstention, reported only to separate retrieval/generation quality from selective release.
overall_composite: Unweighted mean of the four question-type mean primary scores. The sample is balanced at six questions per type.
paired_uncertainty: 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples over the 24 development questions, seed 20260726, for hybrid-minus-BGE deployed primary score.
frozen_route_selection_rule: Select hybrid if the 95% paired-bootstrap CI is entirely above 0.
Select BGE if the 95% paired-bootstrap CI is entirely below 0.
If the CI includes 0, select BGE by the predeclared parsimony rule.
reporting_limit: This stage selects the final text-only route. It does not access the sealed test and does not permit retuning after the route is frozen.
